verdict.rationale: A live-media relay could plausibly document a path into a speech-to-text, model and text-to-speech voice-agent pipeline, so the axis applies. The vendor docs only offer general building blocks: custom tracks, multi-language libraries, and ffmpeg/OBS/GStreamer integrations. The one transcription example is a third-party community build (SageOx) covering transcription only, with no model or text-to-speech stage, so it is a user-side integration rather than a vendor-documented path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech
